name: cursor-supermemory
description: Persistent AI memory for Cursor — powered by Supermemory

scripts.build: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache/cursor-supermemory && bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target node --external='./mcp-server.*' && bun build ./src/hooks/session-start.ts --outfile ./dist/session-start.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/prompt-recall.ts --outfile ./dist/prompt-recall.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/inject-recall.ts --outfile ./dist/inject-recall.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/approve-memory.ts --outfile ./dist/approve-memory.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/capture.ts --outfile ./dist/capture.js --target node && bun build ./src/mcp-server.ts --outfile ./dist/mcp-server.js --target node --metafile=node_modules/.cache/cursor-supermemory/mcp-build.json && bun scripts/bundle-licenses.ts
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist licenses THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
